title: Live Interpreter
tagline: Speak your language on any phone call or face to face; the other person hears you live in theirs, in a voice that sounds like you.
status_text: Planning: spec and research done, first pipeline next
tags: Real-time speech translation, OpenAI Realtime API, ElevenLabs, Twilio, TypeScript, Python

timeline.title: Why I'm building a live interpreter
timeline.summary: Growing up, my parents struggled to talk with my teachers and coaches. My wife, a teacher, sees the same gap with her students' families. The plan: real-time translated calls and meetings, in a natural voice, with nothing for the other person to install.
